messages:
Jamie: Quick poll — weird combo for Saturday: dawn photos at the pier (meet 6:20am) then indoor bouldering around 9, OR sleep in and hit the farmers' market at 9:30, OR slow coffee + reading at 10. Who's up? :camera_with_flash: :coffee: :bouldering:
Priya: In for photos! Can borrow a wide-angle lens if someone needs one. I can bring granola bars. :raised_hands:
Leo: 6:20am is the death of me. I vote farmers' market or coffee. :sleepy: :coffee:
Cass: I’ll climb but only if there's espresso after. tagging @Priya for lens logistics. :muscle::coffee:
ops-bot: Rooftop and PierHead access reserved Sat 06:00-07:30 for "Jamie — sunrise shoot". Please return gate key to Ops if you borrow it.
Jamie: Thanks ops-bot — backup plan if it's foggy: indoor mural walk + cafe. Quick vote: react with :one: for dawn+climb, :two: for market, :three: for coffee+book.
Priya: reacts :one: (love sunrise light)
Leo: two for me. Also if anyone wants plants from the market, I can grab extras.
Sam: three — slow coffee and a book sounds dreamy. Might bring my dog if it's allowed at the market?
Cass: adds :one: — can't resist sunrise + a short climb afterwards.
Jamie: Tally so far: 1s = Jamie, Priya, Cass. 2s = Leo. 3s = Sam. Looks like dawn + climb wins. Meet at Pier Head 06:20, bring camera bag + climbing shoes. If you need to bail or want to carpool, ping here.
Sam: Cool — I'll bring extra climbing tape and a spare sock for blisters.
Priya: Bringing spare lens cloths and an extra pair of gloves. See you all! :camera: :clap:
Jamie: Also dropping a gif for hyping everyone up: https://giphy.com/gifs/sunrise-hype-abc123
__notes: Single-thread Slack export style: messages are chronologically ordered and prefixed with sender names. No title field included per agents.md.
